faust_epic_compat.dual_sword_mastery.des: Dual sword strikes cost 0.5 stamina instead of 1 with default settings.
faust_epic_compat.dual_dagger_mastery.de: Dual dagger strikes cost 0.5 stamina instead of 1 with default settings.
One-handed weapon strikes with a shield use normal stamina: 1 instead of 2 with default settings.
faust_epic_compat.two_handed_mastery.des: Two-handed strikes cost the same stamina as one-handed strikes.
faust_epic_compat.fist_mastery.descripti: Bare-handed and glove strikes cost no stamina. Separate active skill costs still apply.
core.counter.faust_epic_shield_hits: weapon hits with an offhand shield
faust_epic_compat.shield_efficiency.desc: Skilled shield blocking: shield blocks cost 0.5 instead of 1.
core.counter.faust_epic_peak_damage: highest damage taken in one hit
faust_epic_compat.longsword_mastery.desc: Weapons with the longsword ability gain twice the armor negation. Allows sprinting in stance and doubles the left-click deflection window. With a shield, Sharp Stab deals triple damage, has triple impact and ignores 50% armor. Liechtenauer blocks cost 0.5 stamina instead of 1.
faust_epic_compat.greatsword_mastery.des: Weapons with a greatsword innate skill have no item movement penalty, double shield damage and 1.5x armor negation. The innate skill bypasses guards except Impact Guard.
faust_epic_compat.accelerated_thinking.d: Each intelligence level increases Epic Fight weapon skill charge gain by 2%.
